messages.麻痺と怠惰脆弱を付与しつつ、パッシブで毎ターン保護を得られる、器用な怠惰のE.G: A versatile Sloth E.G.O that inflicts Paralyze and Sloth Fragility while its passive grants protection every turn.
messages.麻痺と怠惰脆弱: 覚醒スキルが的中時に怠惰脆弱1(解析Ⅲで2)、表面的中時に麻痺: **Paralyze and Sloth Fragility**: Awakening inflicts 1 Sloth Fragility on hit, increased to 2 at Threadspin Ⅲ. A Heads Hit inflicts 2 Paralyze, increased to 3 at Threadspin Ⅲ. Paralyze therefore depends on the Coin landing Heads.
messages.最後方を攻撃: 覚醒スキルは最後方の対象を攻撃する(一般戦闘限定)。解析Ⅳで攻撃: **Rearmost target**: Awakening attacks the rearmost target in Normal Encounters. At Threadspin Ⅳ, its Attack Weight becomes 3.
messages.侵蝕スキル: 打撃・攻撃加重値3で、敵味方識別不可。的中時に怠惰脆弱1、解析Ⅲか: **Corrosion**: A Blunt skill with 3 Attack Weight that cannot distinguish friend from foe. Inflicts 1 Sloth Fragility on hit. From Threadspin Ⅲ, inflicts 2 Paralyze on hit instead of only on a Heads Hit, and a Heads Hit also inflicts 3 Bind next turn.
messages.パッシブ「ドルハルバン」: 毎ターン、打撃保護と怠惰保護3を得る。使うだけで耐久: **Passive — Dol Hareubang**: Gains 3 Blunt Protection and 3 Sloth Protection each turn, improving durability after activation.
messages.敵に麻痺と怠惰脆弱を付けて味方を助けるデバッファーとして使う。麻痺は表面が必要な: Use it to support allies by inflicting Paralyze and Sloth Fragility. Awakening needs Heads for Paralyze; from Threadspin Ⅲ, Corrosion can apply it more reliably on hit.
messages.必要資源は怠惰4・憂鬱1、精神消耗は覚醒・侵蝕とも20。: Costs 4 Sloth and 1 Gloom. Awakening and Corrosion each cost 20 SP.
messages.耐性は怠惰が耐性(×0.5)、暴食・憂鬱が脆弱(×2)。: Sin resistances: Ineffective against Sloth (×0.5); Fatal to Gluttony and Gloom (×2).
messages.Ⅲ: 威力が上がり、覚醒スキルの怠惰脆弱・麻痺の付与量が増える。侵蝕スキルは麻痺: **Ⅲ**: Raises Power and the amount of Sloth Fragility and Paralyze on Awakening. Corrosion applies Paralyze on hit and inflicts 3 Bind next turn on a Heads Hit.
messages.Ⅳ: 覚醒スキルが加重値3の広域になり、侵蝕スキルの威力が大きく上がる。: **Ⅳ**: Awakening becomes a multi-target skill with 3 Attack Weight, and Corrosion gains substantial Power.
messages.南部ディエーチ協会4課: S3と守備が怠惰で、必要資源の怠惰を出せる。: **[Dieci Assoc. South Section 4](persona:0108)**: Sloth S3 and defense supply the Sloth resource requirement.
messages.開花E.G.O::壇香梅: S2と守備が怠惰で、同じく怠惰を出せる。: **[Effloresced E.G.O::Spicebush](persona:0104)**: Sloth S2 and defense likewise supply Sloth resources.
